title: Compare whole-image and patch features
question: Which features are shared, and what does the patch branch add?
summary: The same board image produces a 512-value whole-image vector and a 14 × 14 × 64 patch array. The baseline uses the whole-image vector. The enriched model appends 196 log1p patch distances to those same 512 values. Masks support inspection and never enter either feature vector.

steps.title: Start from one photograph
steps.body: The same PCB1 anomaly 048 photograph enters the frozen encoder. It returns whole-image and patch features. Supplied defect masks are for inspection only.

steps.title: Keep the whole-image baseline
steps.body: The encoder returns a 512-value whole-image vector. The baseline uses this vector directly. The enriched model retains these same values in the same board order.
steps.input: Same board image through the frozen encoder

steps.title: Measure local differences
steps.body: A separate encoder output has 14 × 14 locations with 64 channels each. Compare these patch features with normal fitting references, then apply log1p to the 196 distances.

steps.title: Append the local values
steps.body: Keep the original 512 whole-image values. Append the 196 transformed patch distances for each matching board. The enriched classifier receives 708 values per board.
steps.code:
local = np.log1p(error_maps).reshape(

np.concatenate([whole, local], axis=1)
